brv_wh_delivery_mikhail.m: Oh wow! Finally, your brother's gift has arrived and we only have to wait for his arrival.

brv_wh_delivery_mikhail2.m: Anyway, it's been a very long time so please go look for your brother.
r: Eh, you have to pay for it...

brv_wh_delivery_mikhail3.m: I already gave you his shield.

brv_wh_delivery_mikhail4.m: Ah, yes, I almost forgot. Here you are.
r: Thanks. I'm on my way again, bye.

galmore_marked_stone_mikhail.m: What's gotten into you? I'm fine, but the same can't be said for Leta. I've seen her pacing in that house of hers, muttering to herself like a madwoman. You might want to check on her.

mikhail3.m: Never mind, he will probably be back soon.

mikhail_achievements_10.m: Just like my father once did, I want to give you a book to take with you on your way.

mikhail_achievements_20.m: This book is some kind of diary, in which you can record unusual experiences and achievements that you may have on your way.

mikhail_achievements_30.m: Would you like to have it?

mikhail_achievements_40.m: No problem. I won't bother you with it again.

mikhail_all_tasks_done.m: Not for now. Thanks for taking care of the bread and rats.
r: Never mind, let's talk about the other things.

mikhail_andor1.m: As I said, Andor went out and hasn't been back since. I worry about him. Please go look for your brother. He said he would only be out for a short while.

mikhail_andor2.m: Maybe he went into that supply cave again and got stuck. Or maybe he's in Leta's basement training with that wooden sword again. Please go look for him in town.

mikhail_bread_complete.m: Thanks a lot, now I can make my breakfast. Here, take these coins for your help.

mikhail_bread_continue.m: Did you get my bread from Mara at the town hall yet?

mikhail_bread_done.m: Thanks for getting me the bread. There are still the rats.
r: Never mind, let's talk about the other things.

mikhail_bread_start.m: Oh, I almost forgot. If you have time, please go see Mara at the town hall and buy me some more bread.

mikhail_default.m: Anything else I can help you with?
r: Do you have any more tasks for me?
Do you have any more tasks for me?
Do you have any more tasks for me?
Do you have any tasks for me?
Is there anything else you can tell me about Andor?
I have a present for you.
I have a present for you.
What kind of book is it that you have in your hand?
Yes, I'm here to deliver the order for a 'Plush Pillow'. But what for?
I don't know...something feels wrong. I thought maybe you were in danger.
I asked around in Crossglen and they sent me to Fallhaven.
Someone in Fallhaven told me that he met Andor and that he was searching for a man called Lodar.
I met a man called Lodar and he told me that Andor probably went to Nor City.
No I did not find out anything yet.
I found Andor far north of here, at a fruit seller's stand.
I found Andor far south of here, at Alynndir's house.

mikhail_news_20.m: Did you go the dangerous way to Fallhaven?
r: Yes and someone in Fallhaven told me that he met Andor and that he was searching for a man called Lodar.
Then I met a man called Lodar and he told me that Andor probably went to Nor City.
Yes, and he told me that Andor probably went to Nor City.

mikhail_news_40.m: Did you go to Nor City?

mikhail_news_50.m: Thank you my child. Keep on searching for Andor.

r: He just said that he couldn't come now. Then he ran away before I could ask him what he was up to.

mikhail_news_62.m: [While shaking his head] Oh $playername, you have disappointed me.

mikhail_news_64.m: Mikhail! Don't you dare talk to our child like that!

mikhail_news_66.m: [Loudly complaining] When shall we three meet Andor again?
r: In thunder, lightning or on rain?

mikhail_present_10.m: I asked you to search for your brother Andor and you did not find out anything and instead you are bringing me a necklace? Go and search for your brother!
r: Sorry father. I will go and search for Andor.

mikhail_present_20.m: Oh, you are such a nice child.

mikhail_present_20_1.m: Hm, thank you. Looks like you spent all your pocket money for this.

mikhail_present_20_2.m: Thank you my child for this wonderful necklace. Oh and it is in our family colors!

mikhail_present_20_3.m: Oh, where did you get the money to buy this? Maybe I don't want to know...

mikhail_rats_complete.m:
Oh you did? Wow, thanks a lot for your help! Please take Andor's training shield - you're going to need it.

If you are hurt, use your bed over there to rest and regain your strength.

mikhail_rats_complete2.m:
Thanks for your help with the rats earlier.

If you are hurt, use your bed over there to rest and regain your strength.

mikhail_rats_continue.m: Did you kill those two rats in our garden?
r: Yes, I have dealt with the rats now.

mikhail_rats_done.m: Thanks for taking care of the rats. I'd still love some bread.
r: Never mind, let's talk about the other things.

mikhail_rats_start.m: I saw some rats out back in our garden earlier. Could you please go kill any rats that you see out there?
r: I have already dealt with the rats.
OK, I'll go check out in our garden.

mikhail_rats_start2.m: If you get hurt by the rats, come back here and rest in your bed. That way you can regain your strength.

mikhail_rats_start2a.m: Another way to regain your strength is to eat some food. You can buy some for yourself from Mara at the town hall. But watch out - I hear that raw meat can sometimes give you food poisoning.

mikhail_rats_start2b.m: If that happens, perhaps the town priest can do something to help you.  Otherwise, just rest until you feel better.

mikhail_rats_start2c.m: Me, I can't really afford the meat, so I just stick to my bread!

mikhail_rats_start3.m: Also, don't forget to check your inventory. You probably still have that old ring I gave you. Make sure you wear it.
r: OK, I understand. I can rest here if I get hurt, and I should check my inventory for useful items.

mikhail_rats_start3a.m: One more thing: Look at that basket on the floor over there. It belongs to Andor and he might have left something useful inside.

mikhail_tasks.m: Oh yes, there were some things I need help with, bread and rats. Which one would you like to talk about?
r: Never mind, let's talk about the other things.

mikhail_visited.m: I can't seem to find your brother Andor anywhere. He hasn't been back since he left yesterday.

ratdom_mikhail_01.m: Good. You are awake at last.

ratdom_mikhail_02.m: As you see. Did you find your brother Andor already? He hasn't been back home for a while now.
r: Eh, what? No, I am still looking for Andor.
What are you doing in my house? Where is Mikhail?

ratdom_mikhail_04.m: We rats took over this village. I am Gruiik, their leader.

ratdom_mikhail_10.m: However, there are two-legs running around in my garden again. Go and kill them.

ratdom_mikhail_10_10.m: And I am hungry. Go to the town hall and bring me some bread.
r: Here I have some bread for you.

ratdom_mikhail_50.m: Is my garden clean of filthy two-legs again?
r: Yes, I killed Mara and Tharal in the garden for you.
(lie) I killed Mara and Tharal in the garden for you.
(lie) I killed Mara and Tharal in the garden for you.
(lie) I killed Mara and Tharal in the garden for you.

ratdom_mikhail_70.m: Where is my bread? Why does it need to take so long?
r: Here I have some bread for you.
Hey - I have brought some bread already.

ratdom_mikhail_80.m: Good! Now I don't need you anymore!

ratdom_mikhail_90.m: The huge rat ignores you now.

achievements.30: Prospector: I collected at least 100000 gold.
achievements.40: Birdwatching: I spotted a falcon high above the Lake Laeroth watchtower.
achievements.50: Lazy day: I spent a while watching a beetle fight.
achievements.60: The secret garden: Near Guynmart Castle, I found Rob's secret clearing.
achievements.70: Hole in the wall: I discovered a secret room deep in a cave.
achievements.80: Tough luck: I must have fallen for every trap in the Arulir mountain. Ouch ...

achievements.200: Sheep in wolf's clothing: I finally found a use for the Wolfpack's hide.

mikhail_rats.100: I have killed the two rats in our garden.
mikhail_rats.10: Mikhail wants me to go check our garden for some rats. I should kill the rats in our garden and return to Mikhail. If I get hurt, I can come back to the bed and rest to regain my health.

familiar_shadow.5: In the devastated lands south of Stoutford, I found an ominous stone etched with strange symbols.
familiar_shadow.10: As I touched its glowing mark, an unnatural chill ran through me, and I heard a voice in my mind, calling out for help. It spoke of torment and told me to return to Crossglen to find answers.
familiar_shadow.20: The presence of the mark grows unbearable. I feel an overwhelming pull to return to Crossglen. There is something wrong, and I sense it's tied to my father. I must hurry to see what's happening.
familiar_shadow.30: I spoke to father. He assured me he's fine, but mentioned Leta hasn't been herself lately. She's been pacing her home and muttering to herself. I should check on her and see what's going on.
familiar_shadow.40: When I confronted Leta, she seemed different--angrier, more agitated. As I pressed her, a dark spirit suddenly manifested before me and attacked.
familiar_shadow.50: I defeated the Dark spirit, but it didn't feel like the end. The Dark spirit trapped inside Leta has fled back to the devastated lands south of Stoutford, where its power can grow stronger. I need to return there and finish what I started.
familiar_shadow.60: In the depths of the devastated lands south of Stoutford, I found the dark spirit waiting for me. It was stronger this time, but I defeated it once and for all. Whatever bond it had with me and Leta is broken. I should check-up on Leta again.
familiar_shadow.70: I returned to Crossglen to find everything changed. Leta has aged decades in an instant. Her child is now fully grown, and her timid husband, Oromir, seems like a different man entirely. They remember nothing of what happened. The spirit may be gone, but its curse has left a permanent mark on the lives it touched.

shadows.10: I met Borvis on the great road near Alynndir's hut.
shadows.20: Since I had told Gandoren about the switch of the weapons, and also the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, he told me to leave.
shadows.30: Since I aided the Shadow once or twice earlier, he requested my further help for an urgent task.
shadows.40: He wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the weird areas to the south of Stoutford.
shadows.50: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford, and encountered an impassable force there.
shadows.60: There were strange glowing, immovable pebbles there. I had to inform Borvis.
shadows.70: Borvis told me that was the basic, but effective, Shadow shield, to protect Shadow incantations from outside interference.
shadows.80: For that, he would give me a chant. But I had to get him energies in the form of four 'blessings' - Shadow's Strength, Shadow Awareness, Fatigue, and Life Drain - within myself. He told me to go to Talion in Loneford for the first blessing, and for information about the others.
shadows.90: Talion bestowed me with Shadow's Strength.
shadows.100: Talion told me to seek out Jolnor in Vilegard for the rest of the 'blessings'.
shadows.110: Jolnor bestowed me with Shadow Awareness.
shadows.120: Jolnor told me to seek Favlon to the west of Sullengard for the remaining two.
shadows.130: I reached Favlon who asked me for 10 Cooked Meat.
shadows.140: I gave Favlon 10 Cooked Meat. He bestowed me with 'blessings' of Fatigue and Life Drain.
shadows.150: After a grueling travel back, I returned to Borvis.
shadows.160: Borvis removed the 'blessings' from me, and made a chant.
shadows.165: Borvis told me to hurry back to the barrier.
shadows.178: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
shadows.180: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
shadows.190: Borvis, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayar with Kazaul's monsters.
shadows.200: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest in the lava wastelands.
shadows.210: We let the mourning woman go.
shadows.212: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
shadows.220: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
shadows.230: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
shadows.240: He accused me of interfering again and again. Borvis, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
shadows.260: Borvis fulfilled his promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his supplies from Alynndir.
shadows.290: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.

brv_present.10: I have decided to give a necklace to my father Mikhail, in our family colors of red, green, and white.
brv_present.30: Mikhail didn't want to take the necklace. He was angry because I didn't focus on finding Andor.
brv_present.40: My father didn't seem very happy with the cheap necklace.
brv_present.50: My father was very happy with the nice necklace.
brv_present.60: My father was disappointed with the pretentious necklace I bought.

mikhail_bread.100: I have brought the bread to Mikhail.
mikhail_bread.10: Mikhail wants me to go buy a loaf of bread from Mara at the town hall.

ratdom_mikhail.10: A huge rat called Gruiik told me that they drove all the people out of this village.
ratdom_mikhail.20: Some two-legs were running around in the garden again. I should kill them.
ratdom_mikhail.52: I told Gruiik that I have killed Mara and Tharal.
ratdom_mikhail.54: I lied to Gruiik that I have killed Mara and Tharal.
ratdom_mikhail.70: Gruiik was hungry and asked to bring him bread.
ratdom_mikhail.72: I found a bread in a bag hanging at the door of the Crossglen town hall.
ratdom_mikhail.74: I gave a bread to Gruiik.
ratdom_mikhail.90: The huge rat ignored me after he had got the bread.

andor.1: My father Mikhail says that Andor has not been home since yesterday. I should go look for him in the village.
andor.10: Leonid tells me that he saw Andor talking to Gruil. I should go ask Gruil if he knows more.
andor.20: Gruil wants me to bring him a poison gland. Then he might talk more. He tells me that some poisonous snakes have such a gland.
andor.30: Gruil tells me that Andor was looking for someone called Umar. I should go ask his friend Gaela in Fallhaven to the east.
andor.40: I talked to Gaela in Fallhaven. He tells me to go see Bucus and ask about the Thieves' Guild.
andor.50: Bucus has allowed me to enter the hatch in the derelict house in Fallhaven. I should go talk to Umar.
andor.51: Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild recognized me, but must have me confused with Andor. Apparently, Andor has been to see him.
andor.55: Umar told me that Andor went to see a potion maker called Lodar. I should search for his hideaway.
andor.61: I heard a story in Loneford, where it seemed like Andor had been in Loneford, and that he might have had something to do with the illness that the people are suffering from there. I am not sure if it actually was Andor. If it was Andor, why would he have made the people of Loneford ill?
andor.62: Andor might have gone to do some business with a rich man in Brimhaven after he left Loneford.
andor.65: It looks like Andor was involved in the destruction of the Brimhaven dam.
andor.70: I have found the potion-maker Lodar, and heard his story about Andor. Andor went to visit Lodar in his hideaway to get a sample of something called Narwood extract. Lodar happened to notice that there was someone travelling together with Andor, that hid among the trees and did not seem to want Lodar to spot him.
andor.71: Shortly after Andor and the person he was travelling with had left, strange things started to happen in the woods around Lodar's hideaway, and Lodar himself seemed to be affected by it somehow. Lodar believes that something disturbed the tomb below his cabin, and awoke the Hira'zinn.
andor.72: Since I helped Lodar defeat the Hira'zinn, he promised to help me in return. He gave me a piece of paper that should allow me to enter the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. He told me to seek out lady Lydalon in the temple for further assistance.
andor.80: All clues so far as to where Andor went point to Nor City. I should travel to Nor City by following the Duleian road to the southeast and look for more clues there.
andor.85: Andor may have been in Stoutford.
andor.86: Andor had something to do with the demon under the church in Stoutford.
andor.90: At Castle Guynmart I learned from Steward Unkorh that some time ago Andor was also there as a guest.
andor.92: Unkorh gave me the bonemeal potion box that Andor had given him for safekeeping.
andor.100: While exploring the town of Sullengard, I so happened to stumble upon my mother and my aunt to whom I have never met. Mother has insisted that I go home so we can talk.
andor.110: After talking with mother back at home, she and I tried to brainstorm about where Andor could be. She reminded me about Andor's friend Stanwick who lives in Brightport. We agreed that going to talk to him might be the next logical thing to do.
andor.120: In the dungeons of Laeroth manor, Kotheses, the torturer, mentioned that he had taught Andor the basics of torturing.
andor.125: Vaelric confirmed that Andor visited him recently. Andor sought to learn Vaelric's skills and left quickly, clutching what he came for. His actions raise more questions about his intentions.
andor.126: In Brightport, I was finally able to meet Stanwick, but due to his hazy memory, he was not able to help me learn anything about the whereabouts of Andor.
andor.127: Regaining his peace of mind after I helped him, Stanwick said he'll tell me more about Andor, once he gathers his thoughts.
andor.128: Stanwick gave me a signet ring that I should show to his father. Jorwick, in Nor City.
andor.130: Andor was trying to find out from Seraphina about terrible monsters in the hideout near the place with the larval burrowers.
andor.131: Elysa in the Brightport's thieves guild told me that Andor has bought a map to the sewers of Feygard.
andor.132: While investigating the Brightport theft I learned from Bryma that Andor was the one who stole the important document, and brought it to her in exchange for her alchemy knowledge.
andor.140: I saw Andor in the mountains of Galmore. We were able to exchange a few words before he disappeared again.
andor.145: I met Andor on the road to Feygard, where he was buying food from Rosmara. He disappeared again.
andor.147: I met Andor on the road to Nor City, where he was buying supplies from Alynndir. He disappeared again.
andor.910: I decided to settle down on the top of Mt. Galmore. For this I needed to find a rich and discreet man to rebuild the ruins according to my wishes. Andor will now have to go and find himself.
andor.912: The construction contract for my new home was completed. I was curious to see what it would look like.
andor.914: I visited my new residence on the top of Mt. Galmore. There I would help the people of Dhayavar as a hero and protect them from villains. Or would I become a villain myself? We'll see.
andor.999: [Quest is not completable at this time.]

brv_wh_delivery.10: Facutloni asked me to help him deliver all of the items ordered by his customers a long time ago. He even gave me an old document with the names and items written on it.
brv_wh_delivery.20: Arcir the Fallhaven book-lover ordered a 'Dusty Old book'.
brv_wh_delivery.30: Edrin the Brimhaven metalsmith ordered a 'Striped Hammer'.
brv_wh_delivery.40: Odirath the Stoutford armorer ordered a 'Pretty Porcelain Figure'.
brv_wh_delivery.50: Venanra the Brimhaven laundress ordered an 'Old, worn cape'.
brv_wh_delivery.60: Tjure the unlucky Brimhaven merchant ordered a 'Mysterious green something'.
brv_wh_delivery.70: Servant the Guynmart servant ordered a 'Chandelier'.
brv_wh_delivery.80: Arghes at Remgard tavern ordered 'Yellow boots'.
brv_wh_delivery.90: Wyre the mournful Vilegard woman ordered a 'Lyre'.
brv_wh_delivery.110: Pangitain the Brimhaven fortune teller ordered a 'Crystal Globe'.
brv_wh_delivery.120: Facutloni wants me to report back after the deliveries are complete.
brv_wh_delivery.130: I reported back to Facutloni. He is very happy.

darkness_in_daylight.10: I met Miri in the Crossroads Guardhouse.
darkness_in_daylight.20: Since I had helped Ailshara, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.30: Since I had hidden the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.40: Since I had aided Feygard once or twice earlier, she would tell me about Andor, after I had completed an investigation for her.
darkness_in_daylight.50: Since Miri was poisoned by slitherers near Sullengard, and healing is taking time, she wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the strange areas to the south of Stoutford.
darkness_in_daylight.60: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford and encountered an impassable force there.
darkness_in_daylight.70: There was a piece of Kazaul ritual there, which I had encountered before. I should inform Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.80: Miri asked me where I had seen this before. I told her about a task I had carried out on behalf of Throdna of the Blackwater settlement.
darkness_in_daylight.90: Miri told me to meet him and enquire further. And gave me a phrase to use whenever he started rambling.
darkness_in_daylight.100: Throdna told me it was part of a ritual to break the barrier which forms when one does a ritual to call strong Kazaul monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.110: The ritual consisted of two parts which I had found earlier, and a chant in a book called Calomyran Secrets. I need to report this to Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.120: I told Miri about finding the book for an Old Man in Fallhaven.  She told me to talk to him.
darkness_in_daylight.130: The Old Man would not let me borrow the book, so I started noting the chant in front of him.
darkness_in_daylight.140: The book contained half the chant. The rest was to be found in another book Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.150: Miri told me she'd trace the book. She told me to wait for her return.
darkness_in_daylight.160: Miri came back and told me that the book Azimyran Secrets was with an old hermit near Arulir mountain.
darkness_in_daylight.170: I met the old hermit and asked him about the book, Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.180: He refused to give it to me, so I copied the chant sitting with him. I needed to tell Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.190: Miri told me to hurry, and pass the barrier.
darkness_in_daylight.198: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
darkness_in_daylight.200: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
darkness_in_daylight.210: Miri, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayavar with Kazaul's monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.220: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest who walks on lava east of the Purple Hills.
darkness_in_daylight.230: We let the mourning woman go.
darkness_in_daylight.232: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
darkness_in_daylight.240: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
darkness_in_daylight.250: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
darkness_in_daylight.260: He accused me of interfering. Miri, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
darkness_in_daylight.280: Miri fulfilled her promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his food supplies at Rosmara's food stand.
darkness_in_daylight.300: Indeed, I have found Andor there.
darkness_in_daylight.310: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
